tasks.title: Persist Mohist prompts and trustworthy session metadata
tasks.description: Persist a Mohist-owned session stream event every time `AgentSession.execute(prompt)` sends input to the coder agent, so replay does not depend on ACP `user_message_chunk`. Include prompt kind metadata where known and fix session lifecycle metadata so running sessions do not receive misleading `completedAt` values.
acceptanceCriteria: Every successful `AgentSession.execute(prompt)` call writes a `mohist_prompt` event to `session_stream_log` before sending the ACP prompt
Persisted prompt events include full prompt text, role `mohist`, prompt kind, sent timestamp, executionId/stage/title when available, and are not truncated
Initial task, plan/check/review, retry, follow-up, and recovery/resume prompt call sites use the most specific prompt kind available, defaulting safely when unknown
ACP `user_message_chunk` absence does not prevent the prompt from appearing in persisted session history
`coder_session.completed_at` remains null for running sessions and is set only for completed/failed/timeout/cancelled sessions
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
tasks.notes: This task produces the durable input events consumed by transcript assembly. Prefer append-only `session_stream_log` events over a new message table unless ordering tests prove a migration is required.

tasks.title: Assemble session stream logs into conversation turns
tasks.description: Implement a backend transcript assembler that converts ordered session events into a structured read-only transcript. The assembler owns turn boundaries, assistant text/reasoning accumulation, tool call start/update merging, terminal error parts, and legacy missing-prompt fallback.
acceptanceCriteria: A `mohist_prompt` event opens a new `SessionTurn` with user role `mohist` and the previous open turn completes at the new prompt timestamp
Assistant message chunks, thought chunks, tool calls, tool updates, timeout/failure/cancel/recovery events attach to the active turn as typed assistant parts
Tool call start and update events merge by stable `toolCallId` into one tool part with status, input, output, error, title/target, and timestamps when available
Sessions with assistant/tool events but no persisted prompt produce a synthetic legacy turn with text `Prompt was not recorded for this historical session` and incomplete marker
Completed, failed, timeout, and cancelled sessions close the current open turn deterministically
Unit tests cover prompt boundaries, retry/follow-up boundaries, text/reasoning accumulation, tool merge, terminal events, and legacy fallback
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
tasks.notes: Keep this as a deep module: callers provide session metadata plus ordered logs and receive a `SessionTranscript`. The frontend should not reconstruct turn semantics from raw logs.

tasks.title: Expose structured coder session transcript API
tasks.description: Expose structured transcript data and trustworthy session metadata through the coder session API. Prefer a detail endpoint for `/api/issues/:number/coder-sessions/:sessionId` while keeping the existing list endpoint compatible for session lists and raw-log fallback during transition.
acceptanceCriteria: A coder session detail API returns session metadata, transcript turns, incomplete marker, and optional raw events for debugging
The API uses `session_stream_log` first and falls back to filtered `workflow_log` stream events for legacy sessions
Historical sessions can be rendered from API data without relying on SSE in-memory state
Legacy sessions without persisted Mohist prompts return a transcript with the explicit synthetic missing-prompt turn instead of empty output or 404
API metadata includes coderSessionId, acpSessionId, executionId, title, status, model, stage, createdAt, completedAt only when terminal, and worktree/cwd when available
Existing `/api/issues/:number/coder-sessions` consumers continue to receive the fields they currently use
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
tasks.notes: If a detail endpoint is added, update frontend API helpers and shared WebUI types in the same task so the endpoint is immediately consumable.

tasks.title: Render read-only transcript page with prompts and assistant parts
tasks.description: Refactor `/issue/:number/session/:sessionId` to consume the structured transcript instead of `Round[]` and render the session as a read-only conversation. Include a trustworthy header, Mohist prompt cards, markdown assistant text, collapsed reasoning, inline error/recovery parts, and an explicit no-composer layout.
acceptanceCriteria: SessionPage fetches the selected session transcript/detail data directly and no longer uses `Round` as the primary render model
The page header shows meaningful title, issue link, status, model, duration, stage, session identifiers/context, and does not show completedAt for running sessions
Each turn renders a Mohist prompt card with prompt kind, sent time, collapsed long prompt preview, expand full prompt, and copy full prompt action
Coder agent text renders as markdown with headings, lists, inline code, fenced code blocks, preserved formatting, and horizontal scroll for code blocks
Reasoning/thinking parts are collapsed by default with size/timestamp summary and can be expanded for audit
Timeout, failure, cancellation, retry, and recovery events render inline in the conversation with accurate wording
The page is clearly read-only and does not render an input box or disabled fake composer
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Introduce transcript-focused components such as `SessionTranscriptView`, `SessionTurnView`, `MohistPromptCard`, `AssistantTextPart`, `ReasoningPart`, and `SessionErrorPart` as needed.

tasks.title: Render tool calls as opencode-style assistant parts
tasks.description: Upgrade transcript tool rendering so tool calls appear as assistant parts within the relevant turn rather than as isolated buttons or a flat list. Provide specialized displays for bash, edit/write/apply_patch, read/grep/glob, and a generic fallback that never hides unknown tools.
acceptanceCriteria: Tool parts render inside the corresponding assistant turn in transcript order with status running/completed/failed
Each tool part shows tool name, target/title, status, duration when available, and expandable input/output/error details
Bash tools show the command and terminal-style output with ANSI safely handled or stripped
Edit/write/apply_patch tools show file path and diff-like summary when possible, with raw input/output fallback
Read/grep/glob tools render compact context-gathering rows but remain expandable for full details
Unknown tools render with generic name/status/target plus expandable input/output/error and never disappear
Very large tool output defaults collapsed and shows line or size counts without truncating persisted data
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Tool rendering should be presentation-only over transcript `ToolPart` data. Keep a generic fallback as the safety net for all unrecognized tool names.

tasks.title: Make live sessions replayable with transcript streaming behavior
tasks.description: Align live session updates with the structured transcript model so live viewing, refresh replay, and completed history use the same ordering semantics. Add transcript-aware streaming updates, reconcile by refetching after terminal lifecycle events, and polish auto-scroll/jump-to-bottom behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Live coder text, reasoning, tool calls, tool updates, errors, and recovery events append to the active transcript turn in the same order used by historical replay
Refreshing a live session reconstructs the same transcript order from persisted history
Completed sessions display full transcript without SSE in-memory state
When the user is near the bottom, streaming content auto-scrolls with readable typing feedback
When the user scrolls away from the bottom, new streaming content does not force-scroll and a jump-to-bottom affordance appears
Session completion/failure/timeout/cancellation triggers a detail refetch or equivalent reconciliation so live state matches persisted transcript
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Keep backend assembly authoritative. The client-side live reducer should be small and reconcile from the API after terminal events.

tasks.title: Verify transcript persistence, API, UI, and replay behavior
tasks.description: Add focused tests and manual verification coverage for the end-to-end read-only transcript capability. Cover prompt persistence without ACP user chunks, turn boundaries, legacy fallback, API detail responses, frontend transcript rendering, tool fallback behavior, and live/history replay consistency.
acceptanceCriteria: Backend tests prove Mohist prompts appear in session history even when no ACP `user_message_chunk` exists
Backend tests prove retry/follow-up prompts create new turns and terminal session states close open turns
API tests prove completed sessions return structured transcript data from persisted logs without SSE state
API tests prove legacy sessions without prompts return an incomplete synthetic turn rather than empty output
Frontend tests prove prompt card expansion/copy, markdown assistant rendering, collapsed reasoning, generic unknown tool rendering, and no composer/input are present
A manual or automated live-session check verifies refresh replay order and auto-scroll/jump-to-bottom behavior
Tests pass: cd packages/cli && npm test
Build passes: cd packages/cli && npm run build
tasks.notes: This task is intentionally last because it consumes persistence, assembler, API, UI, tool rendering, and live replay outputs.
